from pathlib import Path
src_path = Path('src/f1_research/provider_reconciliation.py')
text = src_path.read_text()
def one(old, new):
    global text
    count = text.count(old)
    if count != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f'expected one match, got {count}: {old[:120]!r}')
    text = text.replace(old, new)
one('HARD_FIELDS = ("position", "laps", "status_class")', 'HARD_FIELDS = ("position", "laps", "result_class", "start_status")')
one('    "status_class": (\n        "Conservative normalized class: finished, classified_lapped, dnf, dns or dsq. "\n        "Raw provider status is retained for audit."\n    ),\n    "grid_position": (', '    "status_class": (\n        "Provider-specific normalized label: finished, classified_lapped, dnf, dns or dsq. "\n        "Retained for audit context; not compared as a cross-provider hard fact because providers "\n        "can encode start participation and final classification semantics differently."\n    ),\n    "result_class": (\n        "Cross-provider comparable race-result class derived conservatively from each provider label: "\n        "completed, classified_lapped, non_finisher or disqualified. DNS and DNF both map to "\n        "non_finisher here; their start-participation distinction is carried separately."\n    ),\n    "start_status": (\n        "Start-participation evidence: started, dns or UNKNOWN. A zero-lap generic Retired/DNF label "\n        "from Jolpica/FastF1 is UNKNOWN rather than guessed started or DNS; OpenF1 explicit DNS/DNF "\n        "flags can distinguish the states."\n    ),\n    "grid_position": (')
one('\n\ndef _pit_counts_jolpica(payload: dict[str, Any] | None) -> tuple[bool, dict[str, int]]:', '\n\ndef _result_class(row: ResultRow) -> str | None:\n    """Map provider labels only to semantics that are comparable across sources."""\n    if row.status_class == "finished":\n        return "completed"\n    if row.status_class == "classified_lapped":\n        return "classified_lapped"\n    if row.status_class in {"dnf", "dns"}:\n        return "non_finisher"\n    if row.status_class == "dsq":\n        return "disqualified"\n    return None\n\n\ndef _start_status(row: ResultRow) -> str | None:\n    """Return start evidence without turning a zero-lap generic retirement into a guess."""\n    if row.status_class == "dns":\n        return "dns"\n    if row.status_class in {"finished", "classified_lapped"}:\n        return "started"\n    if row.status_class == "dnf":\n        if row.provider == "OpenF1":\n            return "started"\n        if row.laps is not None and row.laps > 0:\n            return "started"\n        return None\n    if row.status_class == "dsq" and row.laps is not None and row.laps > 0:\n        return "started"\n    return None\n\n\ndef _pit_counts_jolpica(payload: dict[str, Any] | None) -> tuple[bool, dict[str, int]]:')
one('                for field in ("laps", "status_class"):\n                    value_a, value_b = getattr(a, field), getattr(b, field)\n                    if value_a != value_b:\n                        mismatches.append(Mismatch(\n                            provider_a,\n                            provider_b,\n                            number,\n                            field,\n                            value_a,\n                            value_b,\n                            "hard",\n                            "provider values disagree",\n                        ))\n', '                if a.laps != b.laps:\n                    mismatches.append(Mismatch(\n                        provider_a,\n                        provider_b,\n                        number,\n                        "laps",\n                        a.laps,\n                        b.laps,\n                        "hard",\n                        "provider values disagree",\n                    ))\n\n                for field, semantic in (("result_class", _result_class), ("start_status", _start_status)):\n                    value_a, value_b = semantic(a), semantic(b)\n                    if value_a is None or value_b is None:\n                        insufficient_hard.append({\n                            "provider_a": provider_a,\n                            "provider_b": provider_b,\n                            "driver_number": number,\n                            "field": field,\n                            "value_a": value_a,\n                            "value_b": value_b,\n                            "status_class_a": a.status_class,\n                            "status_class_b": b.status_class,\n                            "reason": "at least one provider lacks comparable semantic evidence",\n                        })\n                    elif value_a != value_b:\n                        mismatches.append(Mismatch(\n                            provider_a,\n                            provider_b,\n                            number,\n                            field,\n                            value_a,\n                            value_b,\n                            "hard",\n                            "provider semantic values disagree",\n                        ))\n')
one('    normalized_payload = {\n        provider: [asdict(row) for row in rows]\n        for provider, rows in normalized.items()\n    }\n', '    normalized_payload: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}\n    for provider, rows in normalized.items():\n        payload_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n        for row in rows:\n            payload = asdict(row)\n            payload["result_class"] = _result_class(row)\n            payload["start_status"] = _start_status(row)\n            payload_rows.append(payload)\n        normalized_payload[provider] = payload_rows\n')
one('        "schema_version": 3,', '        "schema_version": 4,')
one('            "secondary_fields": list(SECONDARY_FIELDS),\n', '            "secondary_fields": list(SECONDARY_FIELDS),\n            "raw_status_class_is_audit_only": True,\n')
src_path.write_text(text)
test_path = Path('tests/test_provider_reconciliation.py')
tests = test_path.read_text()
tests += '\n\n\ndef test_dns_vs_zero_lap_retired_is_semantic_gap_not_false_hard_mismatch():\n    support = ResultRow("Jolpica", 1, 1, 57, "finished")\n    providers = {\n        "Jolpica": [support, ResultRow("Jolpica", 6, 2, 0, "dnf")],\n        "FastF1": [\n            ResultRow("FastF1", 1, 1, 57, "finished"),\n            ResultRow("FastF1", 6, 2, 0, "dnf"),\n        ],\n        "OpenF1": [\n            ResultRow("OpenF1", 1, 1, 57, "finished"),\n            ResultRow("OpenF1", 6, None, 0, "dns"),\n        ],\n    }\n    report = reconcile_results(providers)\n    assert report["passed"] is True\n    assert report["verification_status"] == "PASS_WITH_GAPS"\n    assert report["hard_mismatch_count"] == 0\n    assert not [\n        mismatch\n        for mismatch in report["mismatches"]\n        if mismatch["driver_number"] == 6 and mismatch["field"] == "status_class"\n    ]\n    assert any(\n        gap["driver_number"] == 6 and gap["field"] == "start_status"\n        for gap in report["insufficient_hard_evidence"]\n    )\n    normalized = {\n        provider: {row["driver_number"]: row for row in rows}\n        for provider, rows in report["normalized"].items()\n    }\n    assert normalized["OpenF1"][6]["result_class"] == "non_finisher"\n    assert normalized["OpenF1"][6]["start_status"] == "dns"\n    assert normalized["Jolpica"][6]["result_class"] == "non_finisher"\n    assert normalized["Jolpica"][6]["start_status"] is None\n\n\ndef test_genuine_result_class_disagreement_remains_hard_failure():\n    providers = {\n        "Jolpica": [\n            ResultRow("Jolpica", 1, 1, 57, "finished"),\n            ResultRow("Jolpica", 6, 2, 0, "dnf"),\n        ],\n        "OpenF1": [\n            ResultRow("OpenF1", 1, 1, 57, "finished"),\n            ResultRow("OpenF1", 6, 2, 0, "finished"),\n        ],\n    }\n    report = reconcile_results(providers)\n    assert report["passed"] is False\n    assert any(\n        row["driver_number"] == 6\n        and row["field"] == "result_class"\n        and row["severity"] == "hard"\n        for row in report["mismatches"]\n    )\n'
test_path.write_text(tests)
